articles.title: If crypto goes back to the congressional drawing board, 3 Democrat women loom large
articles.snippet: The Democrats who may get a bigger say in future crypto legislative efforts are familiar figures, and they generally look at digital assets with distrust.

articles.title: Australian watchdog suspends Cryptolink, forcing 96 ATMs offline
articles.snippet: The regulator cited missing transaction reports and the company’s failure to respond to an information request.

articles.title: Coinbase picks Abu Dhabi for its global tokenized asset push
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange said it secured regulatory approval to offer tokenized securities from Abu Dhabi as the emirate deepens its push into onchain finance.

articles.title: Luke Dashjr removed as Bitcoin BIP editor after controversial BIP-110 fork stalls
articles.snippet: Dashjr said he is taking a sabbatical from his role as chair and chief technology officer of mining pool Ocean.

articles.title: BTCPay offers $190,000 bounty after bitcoin payment servers drained in exploit
articles.snippet: The project said it will pay 10% of recovered funds, up to 3 BTC, after attackers stole LND credentials and drained merchant Lightning wallets last week.
